title: Mixed named-parameter batches preserve an existing SQL parameter source
summary: The mixed JDBC batch retained its supplied parameter source. Editing that source before binding committed (3,revised) alongside the map and bean rows.

change.description: Both overloads of SqlParameterSourceUtils.createBatch now retain a supplied SqlParameterSource, alongside conversion of maps and bean objects.

notes: Each successful batch used a real transaction and a separate H2 connection for ordered readback. Both conversion overloads preserved the ordinary two-row input.
